topic: GitHub Copilot Usage Metrics Guide 2026: Accuracy, Coverage, and Team Reporting

key_points: Complete reference of all available Copilot usage metrics fields
Dashboard metrics include agent adoption, DAU/WAU, code completion acceptance rate, language usage, model usage
Code generation dashboard metrics include LoC changed with AI, agent contribution percentage, user vs agent-initiated code changes
API and export fields documented with JSON types, nullable status, and descriptions
Per-user reports vs aggregated reports vs 28-day reports have different field sets
Team-level metrics constructed by joining user-teams report with per-user usage metrics report
Guide to interpreting each chart in the Copilot usage metrics dashboard
DAU growth signals consistent engagement; sharp declines may indicate configuration issues
Healthy WAU-to-license ratio is >60%
Rising acceptance rate suggests increasing trust; drop may point to mismatched suggestions
Agent adoption growth shows developers progressing from basic completions to advanced features
Model usage charts represent chat activity only, not completions
No single pre-aggregated team report exists — must join user-teams + per-user reports
Inner-join on (user_id, day, entity_id) then group by team_id
Teams with fewer than 5 seated Copilot users are excluded from user-teams reports
Users on multiple teams contribute to each team — summing team rows double-counts
For rolling windows, join each day's reports separately to handle team membership changes
Distinct-user counts cannot be summed across days — use COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)
LoC metrics provide directional measure of Copilot output across completions, chat, and agent features
Coverage varies by IDE and version — not all IDEs emit LoC telemetry until upgraded
Agent mode does not follow 'suggest then accept' flow — agent edits counted as loc_added_sum and loc_deleted_sum under agent_edit feature bucket
Minimum IDE versions required for LoC metrics (VS Code 1.104.0, JetBrains 2024.2.6, etc.)
LoC metrics may shift as telemetry definitions evolve
REST API endpoints for enterprise and organization level metrics
Endpoints return signed download URLs for NDJSON report files
Reports available from October 10, 2025, historical data up to 1 year
Requires 'Copilot usage metrics' policy enabled and appropriate permissions
Endpoints: enterprise-1-day, enterprise-28-day, org-1-day, org-28-day, user-teams-1-day, users-1-day
